name: GOLMUN TV Korean League Standings API
description: Free JSON standings for seven South Korean professional leagues (KBO baseball, K League 1 and 2 football, KBL and WKBL basketball, V-League volleyball) with English team names.
notes: No key or sign-up needed; CORS enabled; updated about every 30 minutes. English-language Korean league standings are hard to find elsewhere. A dated snapshot is archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24557150). Free with an attribution link.
